headline: Finland's Defence Forces say a drone strike hit the Russian cargo ship 'Sparta II' in the eastern Gulf of Finland earlier this morning, setting it on fire. The Estonian police said the ship was sailing from St. Petersburg to Kaliningrad. It was struck in international waters west of Suursaari and has since drifted into Finnish territorial waters, where the Border Guard is leading the rescue operation and preparing for possible environmental damage. Finland's military did not say who carried out the attack. Prime Minister Petteri Orpo wrote on X that the war is "spilling over into our immediate vicinity" and that Ukraine "has the right to fight back." Russian officials said two drones hit the ship, according to Leningrad Oblast Governor Alexander Drozdenko. The strike came as Ukrainian drones reportedly attacked the Leningrad region overnight. On November 11th, Ukraine's Security Service said it carried out a strike on a Russian warship, the corvette 'Naro-Fominsk', in the same gulf, according to Finnish broadcaster Yle.
